run_convert_bin_to_vec: run the bin_to_vec script to convert a fasttext .bin model file to .vec format on stdout
create_load_fasttext_model: create a fasttext model loader using load_model from a .bin file path
build_get_model_words: build a call to get_words on a loaded fasttext model to retrieve all vocabulary words
test_get_word_vector: test the get_word_vector API to retrieve the embedding vector for a given word
summarize_get_dimension: summarize the get_dimension API call to obtain the embedding dimension of a loaded fasttext model
